responsibility: Defines the ABI type mappings GCC uses to synthesize <stdint.h> for VxWorks targets. It specifies sig_atomic_t plus exact-width, least-width, fast-width, and pointer-sized integer type spellings, choosing long or long long forms for 64-bit integers based on LONG_TYPE_SIZE. Its role is limited to VxWorks stdint type modeling and does not cover broader specs or target hooks.
